Meerut man kills son, dies by suicide over marital dispute

In Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, a man has died by suicide after allegedly killing his four-year-old son. The incident reportedly stemmed from a dispute over his wife's extended stay at her parental home. Police are investigating the matter.
